_description: Probabilistic record linkage results. Pairs are scored on five fields (last_name, first_name, dob, address, zip) using a Fellegi-Sunter weighted log-likelihood. Tiers: auto_link (p ≥ 0.95) → linked automatically; clerical_review (0.80 ≤ p < 0.95) → queued for human reviewer; no_match (p < 0.80) → ignored.
_caveat: Synthetic. Production uses Splink (open-source) or commercial eMPIs (NextGate, Verato). Animal-owner reconciliation is harder than human reconciliation because no national owner-identifier exists; we approximate by treating the owner's name + DOB + address as the matching key.
